rows.reasoning: On HB 2492 (2022) Pingerelli voted Y at House Third Reading on a single-subject registration-verification bill whose enacted text conditions qualification to register on having "provided SATISFACTORY evidence of CITIZENSHIP as PRESCRIBED in section 16-166" and directs recorders to "reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship". That is the rung reading "Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote"; the bill sets no polling-place photo-ID or mail-ballot ID-number rule, so the rungs below it are not what the instrument does. The 31-26 split is not near-unanimous, and the 2022 vote falls inside her earlier term in this same House.
